daily.title: Number of births in Japan rises for the first time in 11 years
daily.summary: The rise may have reflected an increase in the number of marriages in 2024 after years of decline during the COVID-19 pandemic.

daily.title: WWE star Bronson Reed dies at 38
daily.summary: The company paid tribute to Reed, calling him a "larger-than-life figure in WWE."

daily.title: Japan expected to push for debate on nuclear subs in security document revisions
daily.summary: Japan is expected to say in the documents due by the year-end that it will "begin considering and reach a conclusion" on the controversial issue.

daily.title: Seoul monitoring signs of possible visit to China by North Korea’s Kim
daily.summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping reportedly told South Korean President Lee Jae Myung during their summit earlier this month that Kim could visit China.

daily.title: North Korean launderers turn to little-known crypto services to move Binance haul: researchers
daily.summary: U.S. authorities have blamed North Korean hackers for the largest heist in history after $6.3 billion worth of crypto was stolen on Oct. 29.

daily.title: Hackers breach U.S. Air Force flagship Cloud One computing platform
daily.summary: The development could jeopardize a vast swathe of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.

daily.title: Russian military flotilla bound for Libya turns around after sinking of warship
daily.summary: A Ukrainian military intelligence official and a Middle East security official confirmed that the flotilla had turned from heading to Libya.

daily.title: OpenAI says Apple pressured suppliers to shun its devices
daily.summary: The case has overshadowed OpenAI's bid to sell its own devices, a move that would put it in competition with the iPhone maker.

daily.title: U.S. military fires on ship violating Iran blockade
daily.summary: U.S. aircraft fired "precision munitions" into the Pacific Archer's stern after it attempted to run the blockade.

daily.title: Mexico and U.S. combat drug cartels together as Trump pressure looms large
daily.summary: Mexico's recent string of cartel kingpin takedowns aided by U.S. intelligence suggest closer cooperation with Washington.

daily.title: Taiwan goes to polls in tight local elections as China watches
daily.summary: For the opposition Kuomintang, which advocates friendlier ties with China, the results could reorder the field for the 2028 presidential election.

daily.title: Son of Hamas chief survives Israeli strike, militant group says
daily.summary: Izzeldeen al-Hayya and his family had survived a dawn airstrike that wounded several, including al-Hayya's daughter-in-law.

daily.title: Ilia Malinin breaks Nathan Chen’s short program world record at NHK Trophy
daily.summary: Mone Chiba is the leader after the women's short program.

daily.title: Two bodies found on Miyagi mountainside in hunt for missing Yokohama girl
daily.summary: One of the bodies may be of a girl from Yokohama who has been reported missing, according to investigative sources.

daily.title: Japan to revise AI law to introduce penalties
daily.summary: The government aims to finalize the bill early based on the strategy panel's outline and submit it to parliament.

daily.title: Takaichi urged to address tax revenue disparities soon
daily.summary: A governors' association stated that the tax revenue gaps between Tokyo and other prefectures have reached levels that cannot be ignored.

daily.title: Prosecutors to focus on identifying tokuryū crime group leaders
daily.summary: The prosecutors office indicated its willingness to use various tools, including plea bargains with tokuryū members, to identify masterminds.

daily.title: CPTPP members agree to set up support office in Japan
daily.summary: The office will be in charge of arranging meeting schedules and managing documents for members of the multilateral free trade pact.

daily.title: LDP proposes ¥10 million benefits for third and subsequent children
daily.summary: The financial support measure is part of a population strategy the government plans to formulate by year-end.

daily.title: A former loom house offers a quiet look into Kyoto’s bygone Silk Road
daily.summary: In its heyday, Yosano in northern Kyoto Prefecture used to be filled with the sounds of clacking looms.

daily.title: ‘The Moon is Watching’ stages an absurd erotica in the French countryside
daily.summary: Naoko Watanabe attempts to give a subversive feminist reframing to her adaptation of an erotic novel, but ultimately falls flat.

daily.title: Kobe city government proposes tax on vacant condo units
daily.summary: If enacted, it would mark the first tax in Japan targeting vacant condominium units specifically.

daily.title: Suzuki to domestically produce rare metal-free EV batteries
daily.summary: By making rare metal-free batteries, the company aims to curb procurement risks for materials for which Japan relies on imports.

daily.title: A documentarian’s painstaking portrait of Bunyo Ishikawa, the ‘Battlefield Bohemian’
daily.summary: Former NHK director Atsunori Kawamura spent seven years making his documentary about a photojournalist on the front lines.

daily.title: Upper House rejects censure motion against education minister
daily.summary: The failure likely ends opposition efforts to unseat Yoshihiro Seki as the focus shifts to getting key bills passed before parliament closes.

daily.title: Number of students not attending school in Japan reaches record
daily.summary: Over half of the students cited in the education ministry's annual report on student issues did not attend school for at least 90 days.

daily.title: U.S. tariff plan has Japan asking questions and pushing back
daily.summary: Rates could be taken to 15% on most Japanese goods, from the current 12.5%.

weekly.title: Sony launches its new Walkman series, with a price tag of up to ¥655,000
weekly.summary: The new release has "next-level" audio technology and retains features that made the original device iconic.

weekly.title: Japan releases new guidelines on use of AI by Self-Defense Forces
weekly.summary: The new guidelines build on the Defense Ministry's basic policy for promoting the use of artificial intelligence, released in 2024.

weekly.title: NFL serves up trio of thrilling finishes on Thanksgiving
weekly.summary: The Buffalo Bills edged the Kansas City Chiefs 13-10 in a heavyweight AFC matchup, and the Philadelphia Eagles 21-point third-quarter deficit to beat the Dallas Cowboys.
